name: Firstlight · A pond is heading for hypoxia
message: {{#is_alert}}Pond {{pond.name}} on farm {{farm.name}} is forecast to reach 3 mg/L in {{value}} minutes.{{/is_alert}}{{#is_warning}}Pond {{pond.name}} could reach 3 mg/L within the hour ({{value}} minutes).{{/is_warning}}{{#is_recovery}}Pond {{pond.name}} is out of danger.{{/is_recovery}}

name: Firstlight · An aerator is switched on but not turning
message: {{#is_alert}}{{value}} aerator(s) in pond {{pond.name}} draw no current. Context for the hypoxia forecast; a repair ticket keeps it open until the technician fixes it.{{/is_alert}}

name: Firstlight · Aerator failure putting a pond at risk
message: {{#is_alert}}An aerator stopped and the pond's oxygen is heading for 3 mg/L: an aerator failure, with high confidence.{{/is_alert}}

name: Firstlight · Ingest is slow
message: {{#is_alert}}Ingest p95 is {{value}} s. Slow ingest makes gateways buffer and ponds go blind; compare the version tag with the last deployment.{{/is_alert}}

name: Firstlight · The estate's oxygen is unusually low for this time of night
message: {{#is_alert}}The estate's average dissolved oxygen is below what this hour usually brings. The trend in MongoDB watches each pond; this watches the night as a whole.{{/is_alert}}

name: Firstlight · The brain's cycle runs past 10 s
message: {{#is_alert}}A brain cycle took {{value}} s: forecasts are older than the 10 s the brain promises.{{/is_alert}}

name: Firstlight · The AI investigator got a cause wrong
message: {{#is_alert}}Gemini's cause did not match the fault the chaos panel injected. The rules decided the incident; check the investigation in LLM Observability.{{/is_alert}}
